summary: A 1958 FAA-built lookout beside an air-traffic radar dome on Humboldt Mountain in the Tonto NF; NHLR-registered 2002; a 2023 communications project is completed.

facts.design: CL-100 R-6 metal flattop cab with catwalk on a steel tower

events.note: Built by the FAA to Forest Service specifications, beside an air traffic radar dome
The CL-100 R-6 cab replaced a 1940 L-4 on a stone foundation; NHLR does not date the replacement, so the year 1958 is an inference from sentence order
AT&T FirstNet communications-site project: proposal to add 20 ft to the tower plus equipment; decision signed March 2, 2023; project marked completed

evidence.supports: built by the FAA to Forest Service specifications in 1958, beside an air traffic radar dome
evidence.quote: Dwarfed by the adjacent air traffic radar dome, Humboldt Mountain Lookout was built by the FAA to Forest Service specifications in 1958.

notes_for_editor: Height not recorded: NHLR gives '30 steel tower' with no unit, so no height_m is stored. The 1958 build date rests on the NHLR page alone; a search snippet from a firelookout directory row also gives 1958 but could not be read directly and is not cited. Staffing and access are not verified; the NHLR page says only 'in active service'. An undated hiking-forum post saying the lookout is not in use was not read and is not used. Brief coordinates (33.9811, -111.7978) match NHLR and FFLA; no correction proposed. Verification pass (2026-10-08): the Forest Service project page does not say summit or working, so those words were removed from the story; the 1958 replacement year is flagged as inferred above.
